cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(PortablePhysX LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(PHYSX_ROOT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/physx" CACHE PATH "Bundled SDK" FORCE)
set(PHYSX_PORTABLE_CPU_ONLY ON CACHE BOOL "Skip optional GPU and sample DLLs" FORCE)
set(PX_GENERATE_STATIC_LIBRARIES ON CACHE BOOL "Static PhysX" FORCE)
set(PX_BUILDSNIPPETS OFF CACHE BOOL "SDK samples" FORCE)
set(PX_BUILDPVDRUNTIME OFF CACHE BOOL "OmniPVD runtime" FORCE)
set(NV_USE_STATIC_WINCRT OFF CACHE BOOL "Match UE DLL runtime" FORCE)
set(NV_USE_DEBUG_WINCRT ON CACHE BOOL "Debug CRT" FORCE)
set(PX_OUTPUT_ARCH x86 CACHE STRING "Output suffix" FORCE)
set(PX_OUTPUT_LIB_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/upstream" CACHE PATH "SDK output" FORCE)
set(PX_OUTPUT_BIN_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/upstream" CACHE PATH "SDK output" FORCE)
if(WIN32)
    if(NOT MSVC OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "This Windows package requires MSVC x64.")
    endif()
    set(TARGET_BUILD_PLATFORM windows CACHE STRING "SDK platform" FORCE)
    set(PHYSX_PACKAGE_PLATFORM Win64)
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    set(TARGET_BUILD_PLATFORM linux CACHE STRING "SDK platform" FORCE)
    set(PHYSX_PACKAGE_PLATFORM "Linux-${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No portable build profile has been configured for this platform.")
endif()

set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_CHECKED "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE}" CACHE STRING "Checked linker flags")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_PROFILE "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE}" CACHE STRING "Profile linker flags")
add_subdirectory(sdk/physx/compiler/public upstream-build)
set(PHYSX_LIBRARIES PhysX PhysXCommon PhysXFoundation PhysXCooking PhysXExtensions
    PhysXPvdSDK PhysXCharacterKinematic PhysXVehicle PhysXVehicle2)
foreach(lib IN LISTS PHYSX_LIBRARIES)
    foreach(config debug checked profile release)
        string(TOUPPER "${config}" config_upper)
        set_target_properties(${lib} PROPERTIES
            ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${config_upper} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/${PHYSX_PACKAGE_PLATFORM}/${config}")
    endforeach()
endforeach()
